statement: For every integer m >= 2, the source-defined complete cut LP for J_{m,1} has OPT_{m,1} = max(2m+2, 5m/2). Consequently J_{m,1} is fractionally Hamiltonian if and only if 2 <= m <= 4. In particular OPT_{5,1}=25/2>12, so J_{5,1} is an exact counterexample to the natural conjecture that the previously known sufficient non-fractional-Hamiltonicity boundary m >= 2ell+4 is sharp.
contribution: A definition-closed infinite parameter branch is classified exactly, with matching symbolic primal and cut-dual certificates. Exact exhaustive rational checks cover every distinct cut for the requested J_{5,1} and J_{6,1} instances (2047 and 8191 cuts). This does not resolve the original all-(m,ell) classification.
